summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state set and cleared in the run entry point. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests; all pass on Python 3.9 when run with PYTHONPATH=src (the venv's editable textual install points at base/src). Nothing committed. Existing tests/test_widget.py and tests/test_message_pump.py show 'async_generator' fixture errors, which look like an environment issue (asyncio_mode unknown); I did not confirm this against an untouched baseline.
